_comment: Grimalkin's INN register, gated on elevator_pass_stamped (the close of forge_tier_permit). Attached ONLY to grimalkin_inn_guest; the Pallass permit office (pallass_grimalkin) never rides along, so the fitness read, the filing, the lift pass, the study enrollment and every board turn-in stay at that desk. REGISTER-PURE for a [Sinew Magus] off duty does not mean off: he is still measuring. Serve mirrors selys_inn/zevara_inn: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound, four one-verb effect dicts. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: drill-sergeant empiricism. His rig is the biggest shipped, which is why he holds the far-east corner (14,5) -- see the row's _comment in inn.json.

greet.speaker: Grimalkin
greet.text: Sit down properly if you are going to sit. Hips back, chest up, and stop hovering. I am off duty. Off duty means today's session was light. Two hours. Sled drags and stair work, logged.

options.text: Set a full bowl down in front of him. (Serve)
"I'll leave you to your rest day."

offduty.speaker: Grimalkin
offduty.text: Two hours at half my working load. The volume came down by half as well. The intent does not change. And I am still working, since you ask. Fourteen people have stood up out of a chair since I sat down. Five did it correctly. The tall one clearing tables has better hip mobility than half my Pallass intake and has no idea. I intend to tell her before I leave. She will not thank me.

options.text: Set a full bowl down in front of him. (Serve)

served.speaker: Grimalkin
served.text: Good. All of it, while it is hot. Then water, a full cup. Rest before you load again — skip the recovery and the second set is worse than the first. Sit. Heels under you, back straight. Eat something yourself.
